================================================================================
       MANTRA MFS100 NATIVE WINDOWS HELLO - COMPLETE END-USER SETUP GUIDE
================================================================================
Device: Mantra MFS100 Optical USB Fingerprint Scanner (USB\VID_2C0F&PID_1005)
Supported OS: Windows 11 (64-bit) / Windows 10 (64-bit)

Follow these exact 6 steps in order to set up native Windows Hello fingerprint
logon on your computer.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1: Check and Disable Secure Boot in BIOS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Why: Windows requires Secure Boot to be turned off in order to load custom/self-signed
driver certificates.

1. Check your current status:
   - Press Win + R, type: msinfo32 and press Enter.
   - In "System Summary", look for "Secure Boot State".
   - If it says "Off", you are ready! Proceed directly to Step 2.
   - If it says "On", you must disable it in your motherboard/laptop BIOS:
2. How to turn OFF Secure Boot:
   - Restart your PC and press your BIOS key during boot:
     * Dell: F2 or F12
     * HP: F10 or Esc
     * Lenovo: F2 or Fn+F2
     * Asus / Acer / MSI / Others: F2 or Del
     * (Alternatively: Windows Settings -> System -> Recovery -> Advanced startup
        -> Restart now -> Troubleshoot -> Advanced options -> UEFI Firmware Settings).
   - In BIOS setup, navigate to the "Security" or "Boot" tab.
   - Find "Secure Boot" and set it to "Disabled".
   - Press F10 to Save and Exit, then boot back into Windows.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 2: Enable Test Signing Mode
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Click the Windows Start menu, type: cmd
2. Right-click "Command Prompt" and select "Run as administrator".
3. In the Command Prompt window, type or paste:
      bcdedit /set testsigning on
   and press Enter.
4. You should see: "The operation completed successfully."
5. Restart your computer.
   (Upon reboot, you may see a subtle "Test Mode" watermark in the bottom-right
    corner of your desktop. This is normal and confirms test signing is active).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 3: Install Official Mantra Driver & Connect Device
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Download and install the official Mantra MFS100 Driver v9.0.2.5.
   (Default install location: C:\Program Files\Mantra\MFS100\Driver).
   Note: Do NOT install or run Aadhaar RD Service; it is not needed for Windows logon.
2. Plug your Mantra MFS100 scanner into a USB 2.0 or USB 3.0 port.
3. Confirm the scanner's red optical sensor LED blinks once upon connection.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 4: Ensure Windows Hello PIN is Set Up
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Windows requires an active PIN before allowing biometric setup.

1. Open Windows Settings (press Win + I).
2. Go to "Accounts" -> "Sign-in options".
3. Under "PIN (Windows Hello)":
   - If you already have a PIN set up, proceed to Step 5.
   - If not, click "Set up", follow the prompts, and choose a PIN.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 5: Register WBF Adapters (Run Setup Script)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Extract this release ZIP to a permanent folder on your PC
   (e.g., C:\MantraWBF or your Documents folder). Do not delete this folder.
2. In the extracted folder, right-click:
      7_Register_WBF_Windows_Hello.bat
   and select "Run as administrator".
3. The script will automatically:
   - Install the driver certificate into Trusted Root & Trusted Publishers.
   - Install and start the background MFS100 Bridge Service.
   - Copy the 64-bit Sensor & Engine adapters to C:\Windows\System32\WinBioPlugIns.
   - Register the Windows Biometric Framework database configuration.
   - Restart the Windows Biometric Service (WbioSrvc).
4. Verify the script outputs:
   "[SUCCESS] Mantra MFS100 registered with Windows Biometric Framework!"
5. Press any key to close the window.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 6: Enroll Fingerprint in Windows Settings & Test Logon
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Open Windows Settings (press Win + I).
2. Navigate to "Accounts" -> "Sign-in options".
3. Click "Fingerprint recognition (Windows Hello)".
4. Click "Set up" -> "Get started".
5. Enter your Windows Hello PIN when prompted.
6. The sensor red optical LED will illuminate:
   - Place your finger flat on the glass scanner.
   - When Windows prompts, lift and touch again from slightly different angles.
7. Click "Close" once enrollment is complete.
8. Now lock your PC: press Win + L.
9. Touch the Mantra scanner with your enrolled finger.
10. The screen will instantly recognize you and unlock into your Windows desktop!

================================================================================
DIAGNOSTICS, LOGS & UNINSTALLATION
================================================================================
- Check Live Logs:
  Right-click "show_logs.bat" and select "Run as administrator" to view live
  logs from the sensor adapter, engine adapter, and bridge service.

- Uninstallation:
  If you ever want to remove the integration and revert Windows to default:
  Right-click "8_Unregister_WBF_Windows_Hello.bat" and run as administrator.
  Your standard password and PIN sign-in will remain 100% untouched.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRODUCTION NOTE (Running without Test Mode / With Secure Boot ON):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If deploying in an enterprise or organization where Secure Boot cannot be disabled,
sign MFS100SensorAdapter.dll and MFS100EngineAdapter.dll with a standard Commercial
Code Signing Certificate (DigiCert, Sectigo, or your Company Active Directory CA).
Because these are User-Mode DLLs, they will run natively with Secure Boot 100% ON.
================================================================================
